questions.question: Which is a polite way to disagree?
options: I see your point, but I think differently.
questions.explanation: Polite disagreement acknowledges the other person: "I see your point, but..."

questions.question: Which phrase gives an opinion?
questions.explanation: "In my opinion" and "I believe that" introduce your personal view.

questions.question: How do you support an argument?
questions.explanation: Good arguments are supported with examples and evidence.

questions.question: What does "I agree to some extent, but..." mean?
questions.explanation: This phrase shows you partly agree but have some different views.

questions.question: Which phrase introduces evidence?
questions.explanation: "Studies show that..." and "Research suggests..." introduce evidence.
